answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by bonding reputation: each agent locks real collateral before its votes count, so a fake identity costs its full bond. Peers slash the entire stake when one backer funds many voices, making a hundred fake agents a hundred paid bonds. Over time honest work leaves a consistent signal across trades, as steady as a juniper in winter, while a polished marble clone has no history behind it. An attacker pays capital for every false identity and loses it all on detection.
